source: Preserves source values as text and appends lineage metadata before Silver cleansing.

entity_name = ""
source_file_path = ""
target_table = ""
load_type = "TRUNCATE"
key_columns = ""
watermark_column = ""
batch_id = ""

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import types as T

started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
normalized_load_type = load_type.strip().upper()
merge_keys = [column.strip() for column in key_columns.split("|") if column.strip()]
watermark_column = (watermark_column or "").strip()

if normalized_load_type not in {"TRUNCATE", "INCREMENTAL"}:
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported load_type: {load_type}")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", target_table):
    raise ValueError(f"Unsafe target_table: {target_table}")
if not source_file_path.startswith("Files/"):
    raise ValueError("source_file_path must be under the Lakehouse Files root")
if normalized_load_type == "INCREMENTAL" and not merge_keys:
    raise ValueError("INCREMENTAL loads require at least one key column")

qualified_target_table = f"`{target_table}`"
source_df = (spark.read.option("header", "true").option("inferSchema", "false")
    .option("mode", "FAILFAST").csv(source_file_path))
required_columns = set(merge_keys)
if watermark_column:
    required_columns.add(watermark_column)
missing_columns = sorted(required_columns.difference(source_df.columns))
if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing source columns: {missing_columns}")

source_rows = source_df.count()
load_df = (source_df.withColumn("_batch_id", F.lit(batch_id))
    .withColumn("_source_file", F.lit(source_file_path))
    .withColumn("_ingested_at_utc", F.current_timestamp()))
target_exists = spark.catalog.tableExists(target_table)
previous_watermark = None

if normalized_load_type == "TRUNCATE":
    (load_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true").saveAsTable(qualified_target_table))
    processed_rows = source_rows
    load_status = "OVERWRITTEN"
else:
    candidates_df = load_df
    if target_exists and watermark_column:
        previous_watermark = (spark.table(qualified_target_table)
            .agg(F.max(F.col(watermark_column)).alias("watermark")).first()["watermark"])
        if previous_watermark is not None:
            candidates_df = candidates_df.filter(F.col(watermark_column) > F.lit(previous_watermark))
    candidates_df = candidates_df.dropDuplicates(merge_keys)
    processed_rows = candidates_df.count()
    if not target_exists:
        candidates_df.write.format("delta").mode("append").saveAsTable(qualified_target_table)
        load_status = "CREATED"
    elif processed_rows == 0:
        load_status = "NO_CHANGES"
    else:
        merge_condition = " AND ".join(
            f"target.`{column}` <=> source.`{column}`" for column in merge_keys)
        (DeltaTable.forName(spark, target_table).alias("target")
            .merge(candidates_df.alias("source"), merge_condition)
            .whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute())
        load_status = "MERGED"

completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
audit_schema = T.StructType([
    T.StructField("batch_id", T.StringType(), False),
    T.StructField("entity_name", T.StringType(), False),
    T.StructField("target_table", T.StringType(), False),
    T.StructField("load_type", T.StringType(), False),
    T.StructField("status", T.StringType(), False),
    T.StructField("source_rows", T.LongType(), False),
    T.StructField("processed_rows", T.LongType(), False),
    T.StructField("previous_watermark", T.StringType(), True),
    T.StructField("started_at_utc", T.TimestampType(), False),
    T.StructField("completed_at_utc", T.TimestampType(), False),
])
audit_df = spark.createDataFrame([(
    batch_id, entity_name, target_table, normalized_load_type, load_status,
    source_rows, processed_rows,
    str(previous_watermark) if previous_watermark is not None else None,
    started_at, completed_at,
)], audit_schema)
(audit_df.write.format("delta").mode("append")
    .option("mergeSchema", "true").saveAsTable("bronze_ingestion_audit"))

result = {"entity_name": entity_name, "target_table": target_table,
    "status": load_status, "source_rows": source_rows,
    "processed_rows": processed_rows}
print(result)
notebookutils.notebook.exit(str(result))
